newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-WALSH NAMED WEST INDIES CAPTAIN FOR PAKISTAN TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WALSH NAMED WEST INDIES CAPTAIN FOR PAKISTAN TOUR.

text.p: Fast bowler Courtney Walsh has been appointed captain of the West Indies cricket team to tour Pakistan later this year.
Walsh, 34, retains his position ahead of brilliant but temperamental 27-year-old batsman Brian Lara, who is widely regarded as captain-in-waiting.
Walsh has led the West Indies team in their last four test series but this will be his first tour to Pakistan as captain.
West Indies will play a four-way limited overs tournament and three tests in November and December in Pakistan before going to Sharjah for the charity benefit fund series.

The Jamaican fast bowler, who replaced the retired Richie Richardson after the World Cup last year, has led the side to winning series against New Zealand, India and Sri Lanka, while losing 2-3 to Australia.
